description: This PHP abstract class defines a base for serializing API endpoint results in the OrangeHRM system, handling data normalization and associated metadata.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointResult
classes.description: Abstract base class for serializing API endpoint results, enforcing normalization and metadata handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with model class, data, and optional metadata and relationships parameters. Checks class existence.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Abstract method to normalize the data to an array format, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the result as a ParameterBag.
